note: Original factual annotations. Event URLs cite dates and claims; coordinates locate the named place approximately, not battlefield boundaries. BC dates use astronomical years (1 BC = 0).

items.title: Republican Rome
items.text: Caesar was assassinated in Rome in 44 BC after civil wars and conquest.

items.title: Augustus
items.text: Octavian received the title Augustus in 27 BC.

items.title: Britannia
items.text: Permanent Roman conquest of Britain began in AD 43. Londinium is a regional anchor, not the landing site.
items.source: English Heritage, History of Hadrian’s Wall

items.title: Dacia
items.text: Trajan’s wars extended Roman power into Dacia. Sarmizegetusa locates the region; AD 117 is the end-of-reign snapshot, not its conquest date.

items.title: Parthian campaign
items.text: Trajan also fought in Parthia. Ctesiphon anchors that eastern theatre; the marker is not a permanent-border claim.
